name: operating_statement_lines
description: Line items from a trailing-twelve-month (T12) operating statement. One row per general ledger line that carries an amount. Section headers and subtotal rows without their own GL code are not rows.

property_name.name: Property
property_name.original: Property name or identifier from the report header. Same for every row.
property_name.description: Return the property name or identifier from the report header. Use the same value for every row.

period_start.name: Period Start
period_start.original: First month of the statement period as the first day of that month, YYYY-MM-DD. Same for every row.
period_start.description: Return the first month of the statement period as the first day of that month, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Use the same value for every row.

period_end.name: Period End
period_end.original: Last month of the statement period as the last day of that month, YYYY-MM-DD. Same for every row.
period_end.description: Return the last month of the statement period as the last day of that month, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Use the same value for every row.

gl_code.name: GL Code
gl_code.original: General ledger account code of the line, exactly as shown, e.g. 510-500. One per row.
gl_code.description: Return the general ledger account code of the line exactly as shown, e.g. 510-500. Return one code per row; do not alter, normalize, or omit characters.

line_item.name: Line Item
line_item.original: Account name of the line exactly as shown, trimmed of leading whitespace.
line_item.description: Return the account name of the line exactly as shown, trimmed of leading whitespace. Do not rewrite or normalize the name.

section.name: Section
section.original: The nearest section header above the line, e.g. 'REVENUE', 'REIMBURSEMENTS AND CONCESSIONS', 'Payroll'. Exactly as shown.
section.description: Return the nearest section header above the line exactly as shown, e.g. 'REVENUE', 'REIMBURSEMENTS AND CONCESSIONS', 'Payroll'.

category.name: Category
category.original: One of: Revenue, Expense, Other. Revenue for income lines, Expense for operating and non-operating expense lines, Other for anything that is neither (e.g. balance sheet or capital lines).
category.description: Return exactly one of: Revenue, Expense, Other. Use Revenue for income lines, Expense for operating and non-operating expense lines, and Other for anything that is neither (e.g. balance sheet or capital lines).

amount_total.name: Total Amount
amount_total.original: The line's value in the Total column for the full period, as a number. Negative numbers stay negative.
amount_total.description: Return the line's value in the Total column for the full period as a number. Preserve the sign: negative numbers stay negative. Include the amount for this GL line only; do not substitute a subtotal or section total.

amount_first_month.name: First Month Amount
amount_first_month.original: The line's value in the first monthly column of the period, as a number.
amount_first_month.description: Return the line's value in the first monthly column of the period as a number. Include the amount for this GL line only; do not substitute a subtotal or section total.

amount_last_month.name: Last Month Amount
amount_last_month.original: The line's value in the last monthly column of the period, as a number.
amount_last_month.description: Return the line's value in the last monthly column of the period as a number. Include the amount for this GL line only; do not substitute a subtotal or section total.

months_with_activity.name: Months with Activity
months_with_activity.original: Count of monthly columns in which the line has a non-zero value, as a number from 0 to 12.
months_with_activity.description: Return the count of monthly columns in which the line has a non-zero value, as a number from 0 to 12 inclusive.

operands.monthly_amounts: The values in all 12 monthly columns for this line, in period order; extract each as a number.
